posts.name: Humble-Knight
posts.cooked:
Meercat, I'm sorry about your well built villain, but as long as medico and one other sentinel has taken at least one damage by the end of the sentinels turn, I play Inspiring Presence, and the sentinels get out both of their remaining mortal forms, and they don't Block, they can create an infinite damage loop that will eventually kill akash, and there is nothing save an end of days to prevent that.

I could take a picture of the math, but to put it concisely, medico heals 1 point  from HippOath, which allows him to heal 3 heroes by 2. They deals each other enough damage to keep them all able to heal, then with the third heal, medico heals himself again with the third instance. Inspiring Presence means that each iteration's damage and healing is increased by 1, for each instance. Eventually all the sentinels are in low enough health that they can stop hitting each other for every hit but instead hit Akash. Each iterations grows in magnitude of damage and healing until medico heals up to full on an incomplete heal (ie there were left over points of healing) where the process starts over at the level of healing that medico healed by (ie medico would be healed by 9 but he was only missing 5 so the next round of healing starts at 6). This can continue as long as they choose to prolong it.

 

 

Or they can choose not to do that

posts.name: BlueHairedMeerkat
posts.cooked:
Say Medico, Mainstay and Writhe are all at 12HP. Then Medico heals himself for 1 [13].
This heals Mainstay for 2 [14] (who then deals 3 damage to himself [11], Writhe [9], and Medico [10]), heals Writhe for 2 [11] (who then deals 2x3 damage to Akash) and heals Medico for 2 [12].
This heals Mainstay for 3 [14] (who then deals 4 damage to himself [10], Writhe [8], and Akash), heals Writhe for 2 [11] (who then deals 3x3 damage to Akash) and heals Medico for 1 [13].

So Medico's health can fluctuate between 10 and 13, while Mainstay and Writhe can go up and down as needed, and Akash is plinked to death. Nice job breaking it, phanta.

EDIT: I had plans for something similar, with The Scholar being able to heal himself completely every turn, but I didn't think to use The Sentinels as my hero so I could damage as well. That's rather brilliant.
